messages:
maria: Heads-up — trying to onboard MistralV2-8B to dedicated cluster and the Triton container crashes on model load. weights are at s3://models/mistralv2/8b/v1

sam: Can you paste the exact error log?

maria: sure, snippet below from triton stderr:
```
tritonserver: /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libc.so.6: version `GLIBC_2.35' not found
terminate called after throwing an instance of 'std::runtime_error'
Aborted (core dumped)
```

maria: Also see lots of kernel-select fallbacks in the runtime logs, e.g. kernels built for CUDA 12 but host node has 11.8.

lee: ohhh GLIBC mismatch. Our dedicated base image was last synced to ubuntu:20.04 for compatibility — that's glibc 2.31. Triton build for this model was done on a newer image with glibc 2.35.

aj: Confirming — kernel binary artifacts in the model repo are tagged with cuda12.2 in the build metadata. Dedicated nodes currently run CUDA 11.8 driver ABI. If we keep running them we'll hit either fallback (slower) or abort.

sam: Two separate action items then: (1) container/base-image needs update or rebuild against older glibc (2) infra needs CUDA driver bump or we should regenerate kernels for 11.8. Which path is less risky?

lee: Regenerating kernels for 11.8 might be faster short-term for this model, but we have many models that will start requiring CUDA12. Upgrading node drivers is some risk (driver install + reboot).

aj: I'm leaning container rebuild for Triton with a back-compatible runtime (build wheels against glibc 2.31) for now and trigger a separate infra plan to move nodes to CUDA12. I'll open PR.

maria: One more thing: tokenizer is behaving oddly in evals — some prompts end up 2 tokens longer than offline tokenization. Could be special token mismatch or tokenizer.json differences. I noticed `bos_token` missing in the model tokenizer.

sam: quick check: run this locally pls:
```
python - <<PY
from transformers import AutoTokenizer
t=AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained('s3://models/mistralv2/8b/v1', local_files_only=True)
print(t.special_tokens_map)
print(len(t.encode("Hello world")))
PY
```

maria: did that — special_tokens_map is empty, and encoding length is inconsistent with our eval harness (sometimes +2). I think the model artifacts were exported without the tokenizer config.

lee: @aj can you add a token sanity test in the onboarding CI that compares model tokenizer output vs canonical HF tokenizer for a set of seed prompts? If mismatch > 1 token, fail the model bundle.

aj: yep will add. Also opening PR to update Dockerfile to `nvidia/cuda:12.2-cudnn8-devel-ubuntu22.04` and rebuild triton images, plus a fallback build that targets `CUDA=11.8` kernels. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/2345 (WIP)

maria: assigning @aj to the container rebuild, @sam to run tokenizer lint and post results here. If rebuild done we can redeploy to a staging pool to validate.

sam: running tokenizer lint now, will post results in ~20m.

aj: CI note — kernel compile for 11.8 will take ~45m on our build cluster. I'll parallelize 11.8 and 12.2 builds.

infra-bot: base-image-sync queued: tag=redwood/triton-base:2026-03-17-rc1, job=img-sync-1023

maria: ETA on deploy to staging after PR merged?

aj: if PR merges today and build cluster stays healthy, images by EOD UTC and staging deploy at the next maintenance window (03:00 UTC). Will bump if anything blocks.

sam: tokenizer lint: 30 seeds run — 2 mismatches found (one due to missing `bos_token`, one due to sentencepiece unk mapping). I'll attach logs to the PR.

lee: good catch. For the sentencepiece case can you include the exact spm model file version and sha1 in the artifact? We should pin it in the model bundle.

maria: yep, I'll add a MODEL_METADATA.md in the bundle with tokenizer sha and a quick reproduce snippet.

aj: PR #2345 updated: added token-lint job, updated Dockerfile, kicked off parallel kernel builds. Linking build: https://ci.redwood/infracluster/2345

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled for redwood/triton:2026-03-17-rc1 to staging at 03:00 UTC. Will report success/failure.

maria: thanks all — leaving this thread open for staging validation. If anyone sees segfaults after deploy, ping here and @eng-oncall. :thumbsup:
